value.rationale: For a physically motivated local imitation system driven by one antiphasic random environment, the all-size theorem proves coexistence of strictly positive nearest-neighbor correlations with negative remote correlations at low switching and their positivity at high switching. The exact first length with reversal has a reproducible threshold. This is a structural rate-induced length-scale distinction, not merely a finite tally or an arbitrary parameter slice.
